item.title: Notes for setting up a simple hugo website from scratch
item.description:
Introduction

These notes grew out of a discussion within the DODG group at Dalhousie, around how to create a simple website that a student can use for promoting themselves and their work. While I have used hugo for sometime to maintain my own personal website and blog, because I don’t update or build new sites frequently the process to get started was a little new. The below notes are meant to permit someone to create a simple and to teach enough about hugo to be able to customize it. Thanks are due to Github’s copilot AI, for both making the process easier and harder at the same time (e.g. by generating content that I then had to correct).
